entities.name: Vampire Nocturnus
entities.description: A vampire who tells his victims their life will set with the sun.

entities.name: Ant Queen
entities.description: A queen ant who commands endless drones.

entities.name: Borzard
entities.description: An exterminator captain who advises killing the queen first.

events.summary: Vampire Nocturnus threatens that his target's life will set with the sun.
events.quote: Your life will set with the sun.

events.summary: Borzard advises killing the ant queen first, or her drones will be fought forever.
events.quote: Kill the queen first, or we'll be fighting her drones forever.
